headline: A spectacular stock market debut: shares of Chinese robotics champion Unitree surge 500%
summary: Chinese robotics manufacturer Unitree saw its shares jump by nearly 500% on its stock market debut on Wednesday, August 19. The company had days earlier presented its new robot, named Superman.
why: Unitree is a Hangzhou-based maker of quadruped and humanoid robots, and its listing is a gauge of investor appetite for Chinese robotics.
why_moved: The stock jumped nearly 500% on debut, following the company's presentation of its new robot days earlier, which the input links to the listing.
